content: Garava lii ɓa tlǝr ma guha inabi
“Tlǝksǝra ghǝrazhigǝla da band dadda hǝnyhiin kwa dal ba wurkǝs da gata bariyamah kiyava ɓa tlǝr ma guha inabiyaana.
Kaa tagvatag kǝ iitǝr kǝ gana kwab kwa ɗivar kǝ baryam ma vannga, ngal lanngtǝrdan damma guhaana.
“Tamaha karfi vaslambaɗa dlakadura, kaa gwiya dagal kǝ iin dlaɓa, kaa nǝghǝganǝghǝg kǝ iin kǝ uudahiin ar ghacga ba gyagyaan tǝ ɓalla kasukwa.
Aiyama taa kǝ iitǝra, ‘Kuram ndakwani damdǝg damma guhara, ǝn da ɗiikurɗiig ba marauwa.’
Kaa dagal kǝ iitǝra. “Kaa gwiya dagal kǝ iin dǝ vaci tǝghǝra, dlaɓa ard kalkala karfi hǝkǝrɗa hwaasa, ɓagtǝra bandkwa ɓagatǝra nǝ iin kǝ uudahaatsa.
Damma karfi dlǝɓa hwaasa, kaa gwiya dagal tlǝtǝraa kǝ uudahiin ar ghacga ba gyagyaana, amaa taa kǝ iitǝra, ‘Aujilbǝg bǝrnif vanng am ndzǝga ba gyagyaani?’
“Aiyam nǝ iitǝr taa kǝ iina, ‘Aɗaba maay dadda kwa vǝlkǝmnd tlǝra ɓag biya.’ “Amaa taa kǝ iitǝra, ‘Kuram ndakwani damdǝg da ɓatlǝr ma guhara.’

“Ɓǝlaa ba nǝ hwaasa, kaa ba tagartag nǝ dadda guhǝn kǝ daddakwa mǝlgaru kǝ fa hyimmi tǝ guhna, ‘Ɗahtǝrantɗahǝg kǝ lii ɓa tlǝrǝn agha ɗiitǝra kǝ kwaɓa tlǝraatǝra, farzhafǝg dǝ dǝga hala dat dǝga zǝnngwa.’
“Lii dalar tamaha damma karfi dlǝɓa hwaasana, ma waratǝr dlǝgha dǝgiti diivar kǝ baryam ma vannga.
Lii fararzha dagal ba zǝnngwna, tlatlar taakiya da jiguujig nǝ kwaɓatǝr kǝ dǝga kyalma uudaha, ghǝravaatǝr ndakwani ma waraatǝr dlǝgha ba dǝgiti diivar kǝ baryam ma vannga.
Cauwara ba nǝ iitǝra, kaa zavgarǝv ghaiy kǝ iitǝr kǝ dadda guha.
Ar taakiya, ‘Lii araa sǝgal tǝhalǝna, araa ɓaga ba tlǝra aawa palla, agha ɗiikǝmnda ba kalkal dǝ iitǝra, kǝmǝndi kǝma vannga ba ɓa tlǝra, aɗuug ci kǝ dlaɗa faciyi kǝmnda hǝɓguu nǝmnda.’
“Kaa ngwarangug kǝ iin kǝ pall ma taatakaatǝra, amaa, ‘Tsaghwara zangku biya, tagikǝvai kǝ gan taakiya, ǝn da ɗiyak kwaɓi ɗiivar kǝ baryam ma vanga biya?
Cauwacaug kǝ dlayagha dǝg daasagha, na naagant ba nai kǝ diitǝr kǝ lii aa sǝgal tǝhala kalkal dǝgiti na vǝlak naiya.
Mbats ǝn maay dǝ ndzǝɗa ɓa dǝgiti na naagant nǝ ghǝrar dǝ kwaɓar biya? Nii agha shilg kwakyarvad ǝn ɓa hɛrǝr ba vaivaihi?’
“Ar da nǝg band kwan nǝ dǝga hal kǝ dǝga zǝnngwa, dǝga zǝnngwa ar da nǝg kǝ dǝga hala.”
Gwiya tagadatag nǝ Yesu kǝ ǝlbǝg tǝghǝr kǝ ǝmtsǝgaana
Tǝ ɗuula dagat damma Wurshalim nǝ Yesu ard mbǝrzahaana, kaa ɗahtǝrǝtɗahǝg damma gyaba, amaa taa kǝ iitǝra,
“Kiyam dagat damma Wurshalima vakavaki da vǝlav nǝ Zǝra Uuda damma dǝv kǝ maalah ma zhiila kǝsuufah ard lii tsaga adzahadzaha, ar da ghudara kǝ sharia ǝmtsǝga.
Tǝhalakwaha ar da vǝltǝr damma dǝv kǝ lii Yahudah biya, ar da nengaana ar da kalaakana, da hǝrtǝvǝta, tǝ hǝnga hǝkǝrɗ da civanta.”
Ghalǝga babba Yakuba ard Yuhwana
Kaa sagau nǝ babba zarha Zabadi dǝ zarhaan da ghalǝg vak Yesu, kǝla kǝ iin kǝ ghunj tǝvuukwaana ngal ghala dǝgit vakaana.
Aiyama taa kǝ iina, “Au wa nag nǝngi?” Am nǝ uusiin taa kǝ Yesu, “Haiyanthaig yaan kǝ zarharǝn buna ma pal cǝhura tǝ dǝva kafagha, pal tǝ dǝva ghyaɓagh ma tlǝksǝragha.”
Am nǝ Yesu taa kǝ zarhahina, “Am sǝrgai kǝ dǝgiti am ghalǝg nǝ uuram biya. Am hǝɓgahǝɓǝg kǝ dlaɗǝn ǝn da hǝɓǝg naina?” Aiyam nǝ iitǝra, “Kǝm hǝɓgahǝɓǝga.”

Amaa taa kǝ iitǝra, “Ba pakat am da hǝɓǝgahǝɓǝg kǝ dlaɗara, ndzǝgan tǝ dǝvaa kafara ma dǝva ghyaɓara kai bi wa dǝ ndzǝɗa vǝlgaan biya, kwanahaan kǝ vakavakaha, ɓadlavtǝrna kǝ lii dzǝratǝraaka nǝ Daadar kwa ma ghǝrazhigǝla.”
Cinnghara ba nǝ mbǝrzahaan kǝlaawǝn ǝndkwaha, kaa badzǝdabadzǝg kǝ iitǝr kǝ ǝrviɗmahuɗ dǝ zarhabaabahǝn buwna.
Kaa ɗahtǝrǝtɗahǝg nǝ Yesu baɗǝmmaatǝra, amaa, “Am sǝrgasǝrg taakiya tlǝksahi kwar Yahudah biya ar fǝtǝra ngǝɗǝp kǝ uudahatǝra, maalahatǝr ndakwani ar martǝr ndzǝɗa kǝ uudahatǝra.
Da ǝndkwah bi ma taatakaru biya. Dlakulvakwaha, badǝm daddakwa naa nǝg kǝ maal ma kurama, barari nal kǝ kwatnaharuwa.
Dlaɓa baɗǝm nǝ dadda kwa naa nǝg kǝ maal ma kurama, barari naal kǝ ɛɛvaruwa.
Bandkwah dlaɓ nǝ Zǝra Uuda sahi bi mbakyarvad ɓagvarnǝs kwatnahǝr biya, sahi mbakyarvad ɓa kwatnahǝra, vǝlda dlaɓ kǝ shifǝgaan kiyava vara uudah baɗyaka.”
Warghantwarǝg nǝ Yesu kǝ gyiya gulfah buwa
Ar tǝ ɗuula ɗuwa Yariku nǝ Yesu ard mbǝzahaana, kaa gatǝgaan kǝ uudah baɗyak dagala.
Mǝng nǝ gulfah bu ar cihurga tǝ ghyaba ɗuula, cinngara ba nǝ iitǝr taakiya Yesu wa ghuda dagala, kaa dzǝgantdzǝg kǝ iitǝr kǝ ghaiya, am nǝ iitǝra, “Yaazhigǝla, Zǝra Dauda! Zhukǝmdaalazhuuga!”
Kaa cagtǝraacag nǝ uudah kǝ gyiya, ar tagtǝr taaki aa ndzarandzǝg ba ɗǝwa. Ar gwiya dzǝgant kǝ ghai bad halavuwa ndzǝɗahatǝr ar taakiya, “Yaazhigǝla, Zǝra Dauda! Zhukǝmndaalazhuuga!”
Kaa ghacgaghacig kǝ Yesu, ɗahtǝrǝt amaa taa kǝ iitǝra, “Auwam nag nǝ uuram ǝn ɓagkurani?”
Aiyam nǝ iitǝra, “Yaazhigǝla, kǝm naa magha wurkǝmndant kǝ gyiyahamnda.”
Ngal zhutǝrdaalazhuug kǝ Yesu, tapnan kǝ gyiyahaatǝra, batwatsǝra kaa wurgǝtwurǝg kǝ gyiyahaatǝra, ngal gata Yesu kǝ iitǝra.
